sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: Ferenc Deák, 'a haza bölcse' (the Sage of the Homeland), played a leading part in the 1867 Compromise (*kiegyezés*), arguing from legal continuity (*jogfolytonosság*) rather than from force.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: Constitutional rhetoric in Hungarian anchors political claims in immutable statutes and treaties: *A jogfolytonosság elve szerint az alkotmány 1848 után sem szűnt meg létezni.*
